about.title: Trust built into every sheet
about.intro: HTPLY Vietnam is an industrial plywood exporter serving international B2B markets, with a 5,000 m² factory, supply capacity of up to 80 containers per month, and a focus on reliable quality, scalable supply and sustainable growth.
about.quote: Not just supplying plywood — HTPLY brings reliability to every shipment

values.title: Reliable
values.desc: Consistent quality, clear communication and predictable supply plans.
values.detail: Every shipment is checked against the same five quality points: thickness, moisture, bonding, dimensions and surface. That is how the first container and the last one reach you looking the same.

values.title: Sustainable
values.detail: We follow FSC standards for wood source traceability, optimize production to minimize waste, and keep formaldehyde levels under strict control in production.

values.title: Global
values.desc: Products and services built to international market standards.
values.detail: Specifications, packing and documentation are prepared around the requirements of European and Middle Eastern buyers, and confirmed with you before every order.

values.title: Machinery & technology
values.desc: Modern hot-pressing, cutting and testing lines, optimized for dimensional precision and surface quality.
values.detail: Beyond pressing, the line covers precision cutting, CNC cut-to-size with hole drilling, UV coating, edge finishing and surface lamination, so panels can leave the factory ready to use.

values.title: Production certification
values.desc: FSC certified, compliant with E0/E0.5 formaldehyde emission standards for EU export.
values.detail: Production documentation is available on request. See the Quality page for the documents we can provide.

items.desc: Film-faced plywood for formwork and construction applications requiring a stable, load-bearing, reusable surface.
Woven mesh anti-slip surface with high grip even when wet or oily. Dynea film coating up to 240g/m², Acacia/Eucalyptus core, WBP/Phenolic glue.
Precision-embossed hexagonal pattern surface, effective anti-slip with a modern look for event stages and public spaces.
Raw plywood for furniture manufacturing and industrial packaging. Acacia/Magnolia/Eucalyptus wood, Okoumé/Bintangor/Pine/Poplar veneer, FSC certified, low E0/E0.5 formaldehyde emissions.
High load capacity, water/warp resistant, flexible lengths, eco-friendly. Used for structural beams, furniture, pallets & industrial packaging crates.

hero.intro: From manufacturing capacity in Vietnam to the strict standards of international markets, HTPLY builds trust through consistent quality, clear processes and long-term supply capability.

intro.title: A Vietnamese plywood brand built for the global market
intro.text: HTPLY VIETNAM was founded in 2021, specializing in plywood and engineered wood panels for the international B2B market. With a factory of around 5,000 m² and a supply capacity of up to 80 containers/month, HTPLY focuses on developing Film Faced Plywood, Anti-Slip Plywood and industrial plywood lines, while targeting the European and Middle Eastern markets. The company builds its global expansion strategy on consistent quality, supply capacity and sustainable development.
